objective: Demonstrate that the operator is a pure exact permutation rather than an approximation.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run both launches on Ascend 950PR; capture odata1 and odata2.
pass_condition: Pass iff the multiset of odata1 logical values equals the source multiset exactly and odata2 is bitwise identical to the original source buffer.
setup: Use a source buffer with unique binary32 bit patterns; launch the candidate forward with shift (a,b) into odata1; then launch again with shift (-a,-b) using odata1 as the new source storage and capture odata2.
